title: Account projects on a phone
responsibility: Connects the native phone account to the shared project interface without exposing its credential.

inputs.name: CapacitorAccountAdapter.constructor.config
inputs.description: Configuration containing the native account plugin used for status, connect, disconnect, and Hub API requests. The plugin keeps authentication and credentials on the phone.

inputs.name: failure.status
inputs.description: HTTP-like status attached to the returned Error for callers to classify. The function accepts the supplied number without range validation.

inputs.name: failure.code
inputs.description: Public code attached to the returned Error. The function stores the supplied string without validating it against a code list.

inputs.name: failure.message
inputs.description: Optional message for the returned Error. When omitted, it defaults to browserError(code, status).

inputs.name: refusal.cause
inputs.description: Value rejected by the native plugin; a nonempty string code and message are retained when present. Missing or empty values become code failed and a generated message.
inputs.unknownReason: Native plugin rejections can be arbitrary; the handler extracts a usable code and message when present.

inputs.name: decoded.data
inputs.description: Base64 string containing the answer bytes. Non-string or invalid base64 data is unreadable, and data exceeding limit is refused.
inputs.unknownReason: The native bridge supplies unverified data that is checked for string type and a valid base64 representation.

inputs.name: decoded.limit
inputs.description: Maximum decoded byte length accepted for the answer; the encoded length is also checked before decoding. Values over the limit are refused.

inputs.name: json.reply
inputs.description: Native plugin reply whose base64 data must decode to UTF-8 JSON. The payload is limited to replyLimit, which is 16 MiB.

inputs.name: refused.reply
inputs.description: Native plugin reply converted to an Error using its status and a public error code parsed from its body. At most the first 8192 data characters are decoded for that code.

inputs.name: fields.query
inputs.description: Query parameters for a Hub read; entries with falsy values are omitted and remaining entries are returned as text fields. Defaults to {}.

inputs.name: plain.body
inputs.description: Value to pass across the native bridge as plain JSON data; null or undefined is first replaced by {}. Values that JSON serialization cannot represent may fail.

inputs.name: publicStatus.value
inputs.description: Status returned by the native plugin. The public status keeps configured and a recognized state, adding actor only for signed-in and handoff only for pending.

inputs.name: accountIdentity.status
inputs.description: Public account status, or null when no status is known. The identity string contains only the state and actor id, so other fields do not change it.

inputs.name: principal.status
inputs.description: Public account status, or null when no status is known. A signed-in status returns its actor id (or an empty string if absent); every other state returns null.

outputs.name: bridge
outputs.description: DesktopBridge combining the hosted page's shared project operations with native account status and connect/disconnect operations. Account changes invalidate prior project results and protected views.

errors.name: unavailable
errors.description: Native account or Hub operations can reject with an Error carrying numeric status and string code. Known plugin refusal codes map to 401, 400, or 413; unmapped plugin codes use status 0, while a 401 clears the account or returns an empty project list.

outputs.name: CapacitorAccountAdapter.connect
outputs.description: DesktopBridge combining the hosted page's shared project operations with native account status and connect/disconnect operations. Account changes invalidate prior project results and protected views.

inputs.name: failure.status
inputs.description: HTTP-like status attached to the returned Error for callers to classify. The function accepts the supplied number without range validation.

inputs.name: failure.code
inputs.description: Public code attached to the returned Error. The function stores the supplied string without validating it against a code list.

inputs.name: failure.message
inputs.description: Optional message for the returned Error. When omitted, it defaults to browserError(code, status).

outputs.name: failure
outputs.description: Error carrying the supplied status and code; its message is the supplied message or the browserError result when omitted.

inputs.name: refusal.cause
inputs.description: Value rejected by the native plugin; a nonempty string code and message are retained when present. Missing or empty values become code failed and a generated message.
inputs.unknownReason: Native plugin rejections can be arbitrary; the handler extracts a usable code and message when present.

outputs.name: refusal
outputs.description: Error derived from a native plugin rejection, with its code preserved or set to failed and a status mapped from known codes. Unmapped codes receive status 0.

inputs.name: decoded.data
inputs.description: Base64 string containing the answer bytes. Non-string or invalid base64 data is unreadable, and data exceeding limit is refused.
inputs.unknownReason: The native bridge supplies unverified data that is checked for string type and a valid base64 representation.

inputs.name: decoded.limit
inputs.description: Maximum decoded byte length accepted for the answer; the encoded length is also checked before decoding. Values over the limit are refused.

outputs.name: decoded
outputs.description: Uint8Array containing the decoded base64 answer bytes. The returned byte count does not exceed limit.

errors.name: unreadable
errors.description: Thrown with status 0 and code unreadable when data is not a string or cannot be decoded as base64.

errors.name: too-large
errors.description: Thrown with status 413 and code too-large when the encoded or decoded answer exceeds limit.

inputs.name: json.reply
inputs.description: Native plugin reply whose base64 data must decode to UTF-8 JSON. The payload is limited to replyLimit, which is 16 MiB.

outputs.name: json
outputs.description: Parsed JSON value from the decoded reply body. Invalid JSON, unreadable data, or a payload over replyLimit is rejected.

errors.name: unreadable
errors.description: Thrown with status 0 and code unreadable when the decoded bytes are not valid JSON or cannot be read.

errors.name: too-large
errors.description: Thrown with status 413 and code too-large when reply data exceeds the 16 MiB replyLimit.

inputs.name: refused.reply
inputs.description: Native plugin reply converted to an Error using its status and a public error code parsed from its body. At most the first 8192 data characters are decoded for that code.

outputs.name: refused
outputs.description: Error carrying the native reply status and the public error code parsed from its JSON body, if readable. Invalid or unreadable bodies produce an empty code.

inputs.name: fields.query
inputs.description: Query parameters for a Hub read; entries with falsy values are omitted and remaining entries are returned as text fields. Defaults to {}.

outputs.name: fields
outputs.description: Record containing only truthy query entries, with values retained as strings. Empty query values are omitted.

inputs.name: plain.body
inputs.description: Value to pass across the native bridge as plain JSON data; null or undefined is first replaced by {}. Values that JSON serialization cannot represent may fail.

outputs.name: plain
outputs.description: JSON-normalized representation of the input, with nullish input represented as {}. It contains only data surviving JSON stringify/parse.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Can be thrown by JSON.stringify for values such as cyclic objects or BigInt.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Can be thrown by JSON.parse when the input serializes to a value that is not valid JSON text.

inputs.name: publicStatus.value
inputs.description: Status returned by the native plugin. The public status keeps configured and a recognized state, adding actor only for signed-in and handoff only for pending.

outputs.name: publicStatus
outputs.description: Public account status containing configured and a recognized state, with normalized actor fields for signed-in or handoff fields for pending. Unrecognized state values become signed-out.

inputs.name: accountIdentity.status
inputs.description: Public account status, or null when no status is known. The identity string contains only the state and actor id, so other fields do not change it.

outputs.name: accountIdentity
outputs.description: JSON string containing the status state and actor id. A null status serializes those missing values as null entries.

inputs.name: principal.status
inputs.description: Public account status, or null when no status is known. A signed-in status returns its actor id (or an empty string if absent); every other state returns null.

outputs.name: principal
outputs.description: Actor id for a signed-in status, or null for every other status. A signed-in status without an actor id yields an empty string.

inputs.name: CapacitorAccountAdapter.constructor.config
inputs.description: Configuration containing the native account plugin used for status, connect, disconnect, and Hub API requests. The plugin keeps authentication and credentials on the phone.

outputs.name: CapacitorAccountAdapter.constructor
outputs.description: New adapter instance retaining the supplied native plugin configuration. The instance starts without a known account status.
